name: Together AI GPU Clusters - HGX H200 on-demand
price_basis: per H200 SXM GPU-hour, on-demand pay-as-you-go, GPU Clusters product. Fetched 2026-10-04. Preemptible tier is $2.99/GPU-hr. Reserved tiers: 7-30 days $4.99, 31-90 days $4.15, 91-180 days $3.99. PRICE CLASS: this is a PUBLISHED LIST PRICE - an asking rate a new customer is quoted, not a realised, discounted or negotiated transaction rate. A real bill is at or below this and typically well below it once commitments, credits and committed-use discounts are applied.
notes:
Together AI GPU Clusters on-demand H200 at $5.99/GPU-hr. This is below CoreWeave on-demand H200 ($6.31) and significantly below AWS p5en (H200) which has no published on-demand rate in us-east-1. The preemptible tier at $2.99/GPU-hr is the cheapest published managed-provider H200 rate. Together AI is one of the few providers that publishes preemptible/reserved tiers for H200, making it a reference point for the H200 market.

 EXPORT CONTROL (2026-10-04, mechanism-level; sources spl-bis-2026-05-d5-guidance, spl-bis-2026-01-advanced-computing-case-by-case): renting capacity does NOT remove the export-control question, it relocates it. Providing remote access to controlled computing capability can constitute a transfer under the EAR, so the provider must screen the end user; and separately, under the 91 FR 1684 licence regime the consignee must run KYC procedures to prevent unauthorized remote access and must manage and limit IaaS access to the hardware - obligations pushed onto the customer, who must be told to implement them. For a customer headquartered or parented in Country Group D:5 or Macau the 742.6(a)(6)(iii)(A) end-user/parent test can bite even when the capacity is consumed in a permitted region. Recorded true because the underlying hardware is controlled and the provider carries the screening duty, not because access to a US region is itself restricted.

 LEAD TIME: null - and specifically because a PEER-TO-PEER marketplace has no lead time at all. Host nodes appear and disappear, so the availability a buyer sees is a snapshot of what some host posted on the observation date, not a schedulable delivery date. This is the widest availability uncertainty in the whole supply set and it is structural rather than a missing datum: it argues directly for the renting-over-buying decision this record feeds. Probe log in source spl-negative-no-oem-publishes-lead-time.
